title.zh: AI榜单Arena融资2亿美元，估值10个月近翻倍
title.en: AI榜单Arena融资2亿美元，估值10个月近翻倍

current_state.zh: AI model evaluation platform Arena raised a $200M Series B at a $3.1B valuation and launched a new AI agent safety leaderboard, the Alignment Index, which scored 27 models on over 90,000 real sessions with OpenAI models taking the top five spots.
